email.footer: You received this email from {siteHost}. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore it.
email.verify.subject: Verify your {siteName} account
email.verify.heading: Verify your email
email.verify.body: Thanks for signing up! Click the button below to verify your email address and activate your account. This link expires in 24 hours.
email.verify.fallback: Or paste this link into your browser:
email.reset.subject: Reset your {siteName} password
email.reset.heading: Reset your password
email.reset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account. Click the button below to choose a new password. This link expires in 1 hour.
email.reset.fallback: Or paste this link into your browser:
email.reset.noAction: If you did not request a password reset, no action is needed — your password remains unchanged.
email.invite.subject: Your account at {siteHost} is ready
email.invite.heading: Welcome to {siteHost}
email.invite.body: An account has been created for you at {siteHost}. Set a password to sign in, see your orders and check out faster. This link is valid for 7 days.
email.invite.fallback: Or paste this link into your browser:
email.invite.noAction: If you weren't expecting this email, you can ignore it — no action is needed.
email.partyRequest.subject: {name} just joined the party page
email.partyRequest.heading: New guest on the party page
email.partyRequest.body: They signed up on the party page and already got their sign-in link. Tap below to send them the party info email — or remove them if you don't recognize them.
email.partyRequest.bodyManual: They asked to rejoin the party page (their access was previously removed), so nothing was granted automatically. Review below — approving re-grants access and sends the party info.
email.partyRequest.manage: Or manage every guest in the party admin.
email.partyInvite.subject: You're invited to Halli's 40th 🎉
email.partyInvite.heading: You're on the guest list!
email.partyInvite.body: Hi {name} — you've been approved for Halli's 40th birthday party. Tap below to open the party page. This magic link signs you in automatically and keeps working, so you can come back any time to RSVP and see all the details.
email.partyInvite.fallback: Or paste this link into your browser:
email.partyInvite.passwordNote: Prefer a password? You can set one any time from the sign-in screen using "Forgot password".
email.order.subject: Your {siteName} order {orderNumber}
email.order.heading: Thank you for your order
email.order.body: Your order {orderNumber} has been received. A confirmation of the full details is below.
email.order.questions: Questions? Reply to this email and we'll get back to you.
email.order.bookingBody: Your order includes a service. We will reach out within 24 hours to schedule.
email.bookingNotification.subject: New service booking — order {orderNumber}
email.bookingNotification.heading: A service booking came in
email.bookingNotification.body: Order {orderNumber} from {customer} contains service line items. Reach out within 24h to schedule.
email.bookingNotification.footer: This notification fires once per paid order with bookable items. Stock-tracked items are unaffected.
email.rsvpConfirmation.subject.new: Your RSVP to Halli's 40th — we've got it!
email.rsvpConfirmation.body.new: Hi {name} — thanks for letting Halli know you'll be there. Here's a copy of your answers:
email.rsvpConfirmation.body.update: Hi {name} — your updated answers are saved. Here's what we have:
email.rsvpConfirmation.updateNote: Need to change anything? You can update your RSVP any time:
email.rsvpConfirmation.closing: Can't wait to celebrate with you!
email.partyAnnouncement.subject: An update about Halli's 40th
email.partyAnnouncement.heading: A note from Halli
email.partyAnnouncement.intro: Hey — quick update about the party. Looking forward to seeing you there!
email.partyWelcome.subject: Everything you need for Halli's 40th 🎉
email.partyWelcome.heading: Here's the party info!
email.partyWelcome.intro: Hi {name} — here's everything for the big day. The party page always has the latest version of all of this.
email.partyWelcome.goodToKnow1: Bring swimwear for the spa — towels, hairdryers and shampoo are provided.
email.partyWelcome.goodToKnow2: There's a good space to freshen up and get ready after the hot tub.
email.partyWelcome.goodToKnow3: Come whenever suits you — arrive and leave as you please.
email.partyWelcome.goodToKnow4: Questions? Reach out to Halli, Katrín or Auður.
